cefrAlignment: Matches B2 (CEFR CV: can follow animated conversations between proficient speakers, and detailed work-related information): 130–160-word two- and three-speaker workplace conversations that need inference across a table.
examFidelity: TOEIC Part 3 sets of three questions (problem/topic, 'Look at the graphic', next action) with schedules, price lists, a directory and a forecast match exams.ts; each graphic question needs both the audio and the table and has one answer, and none depends on speaker gender.
fixes: Conversation 1: Daniel says he will tell the client they will arrive 'just on time, rather than early', but the chosen train gets them there about 20 minutes early; changed it to 'a little later than we planned'.
Conversation 4: the shoot moves to Wednesday, yet the terrace cleaning was to start 'first thing tomorrow', which is the shoot day or later; changed it to 'this afternoon'.
openConcerns: Conversation 2 has three speakers; check that the TTS gives each of them a clearly different voice.
learnerOutcome: A learner can read a graphic before listening, identify which column the speakers will mention, and combine that with changes of plan to answer TOEIC Part 3 graphic questions and the other questions in the set.
